what_happened: Dispatch named only root-files/settings.json as the hook-registration edit target, but that file is install-once (per its own header comment) and never propagates to an already-deployed repo; the real propagation path is merge-sources/settings-hooks.json via manifest.json's merge_targets.settings entry. The sibling hook (validate-no-task-references.sh) is in fact registered in both files. Research report records the fix: edit both files.

All three declared dependencies (tasks 280, 281, 364) are already closed/archived and their artifacts (shared pattern library, repo-wide lint, hook-registration-path convention) fully support this task's build with no further unblocking work needed.

Planning measured the live repo baseline with the deployed record-versioning lint before writing the plan: 3 BLOCKING findings (all three H1 page titles under lua/neotex/plugins/tools/himalaya/docs/, already declared out of scope by the pattern library's own comment) and 809 ADVISORY. The 809 figure is direct empirical support for the advisory-silent write-time posture, and the 3 BLOCKING figure gives the implementer a pre-change attribution baseline so pre-existing corpus debt is not mistaken for hook-introduced regression.
git-commit-phase.sh dropped 'agent-system/extensions/core/index-entries.json' from a phase commit pathspec: not contained in this task's declared file_scope.

The new hook's own header prose (line 28) quoted the literal forbidden example phrase 'supersedes v1' while describing the rule's forbidden categories, which the live record-versioning lint and the hook itself would flag as a BLOCKING finding once deployed and tracked. Caught via Phase 5's full-repo lint scan, not by the earlier Phase-1 scoped self-check, because check-record-versioning.sh's PATH_SCOPE mode enumerates via 'git ls-files PATH_SCOPE', which silently returns zero rows (false-clean, no [SKIP]) for a file that exists on disk but is not yet git-tracked. Fixed by rephrasing the header prose to describe the category without the literal trigger phrase; re-verified 0 BLOCKING after the fix and after the file was git-tracked.
